roleTitle: Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team members. You will be instrumental in developing and implementing training programs, as well as overseeing our infection control protocols.

This is an urgent opening offering a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour. We are looking for a proactive professional who is passionate about fostering a safe and knowledgeable environment. If you are ready to make a significant impact in a supportive setting, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity for a results-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to make a significant impact on our community outreach and census growth. The ideal candidate will be a proactive leader with a strong ability to drive initiatives and build lasting relationships.As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's reputation and attract new residents. This role requires a professional and presentable individual who can effectively represent our facility to the community, referral sources, and prospective residents. Flexibility to work occasional weekends will be necessary to support various events and outreach activities.This position offers a highly competitive compensation package for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this role in our newly acquired facility. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for healthcare marketing and a proven ability to achieve ambitious goals, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement effective marketing and outreach strategies.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed for events and community engagement.
Strong initiative and a track record of driving measurable results.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and will be commensurate with experience for the right candidate.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Physical Therapist (PT) for a PRN opportunity at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to manage your schedule while providing essential therapy services to patients.

Join a compassionate team focused on patient recovery and well-being. This is an excellent chance to apply your expertise in a supportive environment, contributing significantly to positive patient outcomes.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates are offered: Physical Therapists (PT) can expect $39.00 - $40.00/hr. Compensation for COTA/PTA roles is $28.00 - $37.00/hr.
